algorithm: exact integer q-expansion with a unit-triangular Laurent-series solve
normalization: symmetric, degree ell+1 in X and Y, coefficients of X^(ell+1) and Y^(ell+1) equal to 1

validation.q_series: Each generated identity is checked through q^(ell*(ell+1)+8), beyond the q^0 coefficient used to solve it.
validation.legacy_fixtures: Generated levels 2 and 3 byte-match the pre-existing repository fixtures.
validation.level_5_independent: Five 5-isogenies over F_101 are constructed with group arithmetic and Velu formulas; every (j(E),j(E/G)) specialization is a root modulo 101.

upstream_cross_check.role: coefficient comparison only; the output is generated from q-series, not copied
